India's GST Collections See Robust Growth in June

The Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections in India grew 13.9% to ₹1.95 lakh crore in June, driven by strong import revenues. This growth is attributed to the maturing and resilient nature of India's tax system. The increase in refund disbursements also supported businesses.
